legend.P: An allowable use in the district, subject to any referenced performance standards and all other applicable regulations of the Ordinance. Under an overlay column, the use is allowable as a permitted use in the overlay district whether or not the underlying base district prohibits it.
legend.C: An allowable use in the district only on approval of a Conditional Use Permit (Section 2.4.8), subject to any referenced performance standards and all other applicable regulations.
legend.P/C: An allowable use in the district, but a Conditional Use Permit (Section 2.4.8) may be required, as determined by the applicable performance standards.
legend.blank: Prohibited as a principal or conditional use in the district. Under an overlay column, prohibited whether or not the underlying base district allows it.
legend.unlisted: Any use that is not listed in a use table is prohibited (Section 3.1.4).
